Bench run_qctl_static.sh: lockstep vs the reference calendar on the raw pins, every edge (MUT0 pass; MUT1 programme bit, MUT2 slot strap, MUT3 latency fail). The whole-client lockstep run_quad_lockstep.sh (ot-epyc4 lock5) covers the composition.
